impression-to-invoice.title: From Impression to Invoice — Streamlining Campaign Operations
impression-to-invoice.subtitle: How operational precision helped a genealogy-focused ad network scale revenue, trust, and efficiency

sections.heading: Client
sections.body: A US-based programmatic display ad network operating in the genealogy domain, managing campaigns across multiple DSPs and premium supply partners.

sections.heading: The Business Context
sections.body: Operating in a high-intent vertical with over 300 million annual ad requests, the client faced increasing pressure to maintain billing accuracy, operational transparency, and advertiser trust while scaling revenue.

sections.heading: Operational Challenges
bullets: Discrepancies between planned and delivered impressions
Manual reconciliation of delivery and billing data
Frequent invoice disputes with advertisers and DSPs

sections.heading: Our Approach
sections.body: We embedded directly into the client’s ad operations workflow, introducing structured trafficking processes, automated delivery checks, and standardized reporting frameworks across all demand and supply partners.

sections.heading: Results Delivered
bullets: Faster campaign setup and optimization cycles

sections.heading: Key Takeaway
sections.body: Operational discipline and transparent reporting can transform billing from a friction point into a competitive advantage.

transition-enablers.title: Transition Enablers in a Complex Organizational Shift
transition-enablers.subtitle: Supporting enterprise restructuring with operational continuity and platform stability

sections.heading: Client
sections.body: A large enterprise undergoing acquisition-led restructuring, impacting internal teams, vendors, and operational workflows.

sections.heading: The Business Context
sections.body: Following multiple acquisitions, the organization faced fragmented ownership of ad platforms, undocumented workflows, and increasing dependency on external vendors.

sections.heading: Operational Challenges
bullets: High risk of operational downtime during transition

sections.heading: Our Role
sections.body: We acted as the operational backbone—maintaining continuity across platforms, documenting workflows, and ensuring campaigns continued without disruption during internal restructuring.

sections.heading: Outcomes
bullets: Clear documentation enabling internal team handover

sections.heading: Key Takeaway
sections.body: Strong operational stewardship preserves trust, performance, and continuity during periods of organizational change.
